```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, 
  warning = FALSE, 
  message = FALSE, 
  fig.align = "center"
)

library(tigris)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(rstatix)
library(knitr)
library(moments)
library(patchwork)
library(effsize)

options(scipen = 999, tigris_class = "sf", tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# 1. Load Census 2010 boundaries
ne_blocks <- block_groups(state = "NE", county = c("Douglas", "Sarpy"), year = 2010, cb = TRUE)
ia_blocks <- block_groups(state = "IA", county = "Pottawattamie", year = 2010, cb = TRUE)

metro_shapes <- rbind(ne_blocks, ia_blocks) %>%
  mutate(GEOID12 = str_extract(as.character(GEO_ID), "\\d{12}$"))

# 2. Ingest and prepare EPA Smart Location Database
sld_omaha <- fread("EPA_SDL_OmahaCouncilBluffs.csv")

# Derive Pct_ZeroCar
if (all(c("AutoOwn0", "TotHH") %in% names(sld_omaha))) {
  sld_omaha[, `:=`(AutoOwn0 = as.numeric(AutoOwn0), TotHH = as.numeric(TotHH))]
  sld_omaha[, Pct_ZeroCar := fifelse(TotHH > 0, (AutoOwn0 / TotHH) * 100, NA_real_)]
} else if ("D1D" %in% names(sld_omaha)) {
  sld_omaha[, Pct_ZeroCar := as.numeric(D1D)]
}

# 7-Indicator analysis vector
analysis_vars <- c("NatWalkInd", "D1A", "D2A_JPHH", "D3A", "D5AR", "D5CR", "Pct_ZeroCar")

# Reconstruct 12-digit FIPS to circumvent Excel integer truncation
clean_data <- sld_omaha %>%
  mutate(
    jurisdiction = if_else(as.character(STATEFP) == "19", "Council Bluffs (IA)", "Omaha (NE)"),
    GEOID12 = paste0(
      str_pad(as.character(STATEFP),  width = 2, side = "left", pad = "0"),
      str_pad(as.character(COUNTYFP), width = 3, side = "left", pad = "0"),
      str_pad(as.character(TRACTCE),  width = 6, side = "left", pad = "0"),
      str_pad(as.character(BLKGRPCE), width = 1, side = "left", pad = "0")
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(any_of(analysis_vars), as.numeric))

# Spatial merge
metro_map_sf <- metro_shapes %>%
  inner_join(clean_data, by = "GEOID12")
```

```{r}
# Mann-Whitney U test with Bonferroni correction
comparison_results <- clean_data %>%
  select(jurisdiction, all_of(analysis_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(analysis_vars), names_to = "indicator", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(indicator) %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(value ~ jurisdiction) %>%
  rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "bonferroni") %>%
  rstatix::add_significance("p.adj")

# Cliff's Delta effect size and 95% Confidence Intervals
effect_sizes <- clean_data %>%
  select(jurisdiction, all_of(analysis_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(analysis_vars), names_to = "indicator", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(indicator) %>%
  summarise(
    res = list(effsize::cliff.delta(value ~ jurisdiction, conf.level = 0.95)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    effsize   = map_dbl(res, ~ round(.x$estimate, 3)),
    conf.low  = map_dbl(res, ~ round(.x$conf.int[1], 3)),
    conf.high = map_dbl(res, ~ round(.x$conf.int[2], 3)),
    magnitude = map_chr(res, ~ as.character(.x$magnitude))
  ) %>%
  select(indicator, effsize, conf.low, conf.high, magnitude)

# Summary table
full_5d_table <- left_join(comparison_results, effect_sizes, by = "indicator") %>%
  mutate(
    Dimension = case_when(
      indicator == "NatWalkInd"  ~ "Composite Walkability Index",
      indicator == "D1A"         ~ "D1: Activity Density (Pop+Jobs/Acre)",
      indicator == "D2A_JPHH"    ~ "D2: Diversity (Jobs/HH Ratio)",
      indicator == "D3A"         ~ "D3: Design (Intersection Density)",
      indicator == "D5AR"        ~ "D5: Auto Dest. Accessibility (45m Jobs)",
      indicator == "D5CR"        ~ "D5: Transit Dest. Accessibility (45m Jobs)",
      indicator == "Pct_ZeroCar" ~ "Auto: Zero-Vehicle Households (%)",
      TRUE                       ~ indicator
    ),
    p.adj_formatted = if_else(p.adj < 0.0001, "< 0.0001", as.character(round(p.adj, 4))),
    statistic = round(statistic, 0),
    CI_95 = paste0("[", conf.low, ", ", conf.high, "]")
  ) %>%
  select(
    Dimension,
    `n (CB)` = n1,
    `n (OMA)` = n2,
    `W Statistic` = statistic,
    `Bonferroni p` = p.adj_formatted,
    `Sig.` = p.adj.signif,
    `Cliff's Delta` = effsize,
    `95% CI` = CI_95,
    Magnitude = magnitude
  )

kable(full_5d_table, caption = "Built Environment & Transit Differences: Omaha vs. Council Bluffs", align = "lcccccccl")
```



To determine if transit equity and access differ across state lines, we compared the EPA 5D's and household vehicle access between Council bluffs and Omaha. Analysis showed a non normal distribution with all included variables having high skew and kurtosis. As a result two-tailed Mann-Whitney U tests were used to determine differences between the Omaha (n = ) and Council bluffs (n = ) metro. Cliffs delta was used to estimate effect sizes. To protect against type I error a bonferonni correction was used on the seven planned tests. 
 Composite Walkability Index (NatWalkInd): Omaha and council bluffs were significantly different  (W=12,661, p_"adj" <0.0001, δ=-0.571) such that Omaha had significantly higher walkability. 
Activity Density (D1A):  Omaha had significantly greater population and job density (W=20,586, p_"adj" <0.0001, δ=-0.302) compared to council bluffs.
D3: Street Intersection Density (D3A): Significant (W=21,982, p_"adj" =0.0005, δ=-0.254) such that Omaha has denser intersections.
D5: Auto Destination Accessibility (D5AR): Significant (W=10,294, p_"adj" <0.0001, δ=-0.651, large effect) such that Omaha has a greater number of jobs accessed by motor vehicle.
D5: Transit Destination Accessibility (D5CR): Significant (W=10,294, p_"adj" <0.0001, δ=-0.651, large effect) such that Omaha had a greater number of jobs accessible via public transit.  
Zero-Vehicle Households (Pct_ZeroCar): Significant (W=20,045, p_"adj" <0.0001, δ=-0.320) such that Omaha had a greater proportion of households with 0 cars.  



```{r}
equity_sf <- metro_map_sf %>%
  filter(!is.na(Pct_ZeroCar) & !is.na(D5CR)) %>%
  mutate(
    need_cat   = ntile(Pct_ZeroCar, 3),
    access_cat = ntile(rank(D5CR, ties.method = "min"), 3),
    group      = paste0(need_cat, "-", access_cat)
  )

bivariate_colors <- c(
  "1-1" = "#e8e8e8", "1-2" = "#b0d5df", "1-3" = "#64acbe",
  "2-1" = "#e4acac", "2-2" = "#ad9ea5", "2-3" = "#627f8c",
  "3-1" = "#c85a5a", "3-2" = "#985356", "3-3" = "#564249"
)

ne_outline <- metro_map_sf %>% filter(jurisdiction == "Omaha (NE)") %>% st_union()
ia_outline <- metro_map_sf %>% filter(jurisdiction == "Council Bluffs (IA)") %>% st_union()
river_border_line <- st_intersection(st_boundary(ne_outline), st_boundary(ia_outline)) %>%
  st_collection_extract("LINESTRING")

p_map <- ggplot(equity_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = group), color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.05) +
  geom_sf(data = river_border_line, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bivariate_colors, guide = "none") +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-96.16, -95.78),
    ylim = c(41.13, 41.36),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(
    title = "Transit Equity Mismatch: Omaha Metro vs. Council Bluffs",
    subtitle = "Dark Red = High Zero-Car / Low Transit Job Reach"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30", margin = margin(b = 8))
  )

legend_df <- expand.grid(need = 1:3, access = 1:3) %>%
  mutate(group = paste0(need, "-", access))

p_legend <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = access, y = need, fill = group)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bivariate_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c("Low", "Med", "High")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c("Low", "Med", "High")) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(x = "Transit Access (D5CR) →", y = "Zero-Car HHs (%) →") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

p_map + p_legend + plot_layout(widths = c(3.5, 1))

```
